column1: # Key types Blindspot looks for. One line each, tab separated, most specific first: the first
# line whose start matches names the provider. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
# A new id must also be added to PROVIDERS in gird.ai's Worker, or gird.ai drops it from the
# counts. Patterns are POSIX extended regexes that .NET reads the same way. Older OpenAI project
# keys are 48 characters after sk-proj-: 20, then T3BlbkFJ (OpenAI in base64), then 20; newer ones
# are 156 (OpenAI's community forum, GitGuardian's OpenAI detectors, gitleaks and TruffleHog).
# A Bedrock short-term key is bedrock-api-key- and the base64 of a signed bedrock.amazonaws.com address,
# so its fixed start is followed by 60 more base64 characters at least: the start alone is text about
# keys, such as this file, which an agent may have read into its session.
# A GitHub server-to-server token is ghs_ and 36 letters and digits, or, since GitHub's stateless
# tokens of April 2026, ghs_ and a JWT of about 520 characters with two dots (GitHub's changelog of
# 24 April 2026). Neither may follow a letter, digit or _: words such as troughs_ and highs_ hold ghs_.
# Google's AIza and Replicate's r8_ keys must not follow a base64 letter, digit, + or /: agents keep
# pasted images as base64 in their sessions, and random base64 holds AIza and 35 key characters about
# twice in 100 MB.
